blurb: No Shoes Cruises offers personalized boat tours on a 27-foot tritoon vessel on Lake George in the Adirondack region of New York. The boat features an exceptional sound system to play music matching passengers' tastes. Tours visit beautiful parts of Lake George and showcase natural beauty and extraordinary homes.
